# PilotStack

> PilotStack is an independent software research site that helps buyers choose the right tools. We publish hands-on reviews, head-to-head comparisons, best-software guides, market research, and pricing data across 12 categories including CRM, project management, analytics, developer tools, HR, and marketing.
